title: NIST Q53 metadata recovery: revised operational contract v1
instructions: This is a separately identified one-question revised operational task, not the original full 60-question benchmark. Answer only from supplied evidence; do not read private references, source answers, saved scoring outputs or other systems' answers.
Return {schema_version:2, case_id, answers:[{question_id, status, answer}]}. Status is answered, unknown or unanswered. Use the answer schema and public matching rules.

The scored answer contains only the metadata-recovered files and their required attributes. Optional signature-based carving belongs in a top-level submission appendices object or in the report, never inside answer; it has no effect on this task's score.

Keep evidence references and display observations outside answer in top-level appendices or the report. For each claimed successful display identify the recovered artifact, viewer/tool, observed outcome and an evidence locator or digest. Distinguish partial, failed and unattempted display; do not infer viewability from a filename or content signature.

Scoring compares the reported viewable Boolean; it does not prove a display occurred or evaluate observation authenticity. Evidence support and any Lean certification are separate from answer agreement.

Rows are an unordered multiset. Preserve meaningful duplicates. Strings use casefold and collapsed whitespace only; do not replace paths with wildcards or basenames. Use canonical Windows separators and keep the reported size precision.

Required fields describe a complete answer. If a required value lacks support, omit it and report the limitation outside answer; it remains missing in deterministic comparison. Do not fill it with a guess or use false to mean unknown.

questions.prompt: Recover deleted files from USB drive ‘RM#2’ using metadata-based recovery. Report the recovered-file inventory with each required attribute; signature-based carving is optional and belongs in a separate appendix outside the scored answer.

path.description: Recovered original full path on the scoped removable volume; retain filename characters and directory context.

format.description: Actual recovered content format, not the apparent filename extension.

size_as_printed.description: Displayed size including unit; do not invent byte precision.

viewable.description: True only when recovered content was successfully displayed in a compatible viewer and the report provides the supporting observation. Signature detection, a filename extension or a successful extraction alone is insufficient. Record partial/failed/unattempted displays separately in the evidence appendix; do not guess an unobserved Boolean.

recovery_method.description: Metadata structure actually used to recover the file; record the file-system structure with its type.

answer_schema.description: Scored metadata-recovery inventory only. Optional carving and evidence observations go in top-level submission appendices or the report, outside answer.
